title: Spectrum
description: Raw NIR spectrum payload. Immutable, large — stored separately from measurement. 228 bands × 3 repeats. Wi-Fi only sync by default.

measurement_id.description: UUIDv7 of the parent measurement record.

sensor_model.description: Physical sensor model. Determines wavelength grid and calibration polynomial.

wavelengths_nm.description: Wavelength axis in nanometres. Length determines number of bands. Hamamatsu: 228 bands 340–850nm. AS7265x: 18 bands 410–940nm.

items.description: One repeat: raw ADC counts per band.

intensities_raw.description: Outer array = repeats (3 for production scan). Inner array = counts per wavelength band.

intensities_corrected.description: Corrected reflectance: (raw - dark) / (white - dark). Same shape as intensities_raw.

dark_reference.description: Dark reference counts captured with shutter closed. Same length as wavelengths_nm.

white_reference.description: White reference counts from Spectralon tile. Captured at scan start. Same length as wavelengths_nm.

repeats.description: Number of spectral sweeps in this capture. Production: 3.

integration_time_us.description: Sensor integration time in microseconds. Auto-selected to avoid saturation.

snr_db.description: Estimated signal-to-noise ratio in dB. Computed from repeat variance. < 20 dB triggers a retake prompt.

saturation_bands.description: Indices of any saturated bands (count at max ADC). Should be empty for a good scan.

temperature_compensation_applied.description: Whether temperature drift correction was applied using BME688 reading.

calibration_id.description: ID of the calibration file that was active when this spectrum was captured.

preprocessing_applied.description: Ordered list of preprocessing steps applied before inference. e.g. ['snv', 'savitzky_golay_11_2']
